resources.string: The internal profile is used only after grab is turned on from the Internal page.
Hold for the eraser, and release to return to the pen tip. A shortcut clicks once and does not repeat while held.

On this tablet the tail eraser and the pen\'s second side button are the same signal. A shortcut clicks once and does not repeat while held. The second side button can be pressed again without leaving hover. The tail eraser clicks again only after it leaves the sensing range and comes back.
Hide the pen tool while the eraser is down
The internal profile is used only after grab is turned on from the Internal page. Coordinates stay unchanged; only pressure is rewritten.

Horizontal is how hard you press. Vertical is the pressure sent to the system. The left node\'s horizontal position is the low deadzone: below it, output stays at the start. The right node is the high deadzone: above it, output pins to the end.

The internal pen has no area mapping. Choose Internal pen on the pressure and button pages; that profile is stored separately from the external tablet. This page only decides whether to grab the internal pen.

After it is on, the built-in pen is grabbed. Coordinates pass through, and only this profile\'s pressure and side buttons change. On the Samsung pen, the dock, cover, hover distance, and the original Home key are forwarded unchanged.
Left is the tablet, right is the screen. Tablet rotation can be combined with the crop and the rectangles. When the screen turns, the proportions on the right follow immediately.
